shortDescription: GitHub-style home dashboard view in its default state.
fullDescription: Presents the github-home-dashboard view with a dark three-column layout including the global top bar, repository sidebar, central feed composer, trending and recommended repository cards, and a right rail with Copilot Day and changelog panels. Supports the default state through props for userName, leftRepositories, sections, and state, while keeping search fields, menus, and repository star actions interactive with local presentational state.
